preferences: Backend: SAP CAP Node.js with TypeScript (strict). Structure db/ for CDS models + db/data seed CSVs, srv/<name>-service.cds + srv/<name>-service.ts, srv/handlers/*.handler.ts (thin CAP boundary), srv/services/*.service.ts (business logic as exported functions). No classes except the CAP ApplicationService, no repository layer, use CQL (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE) not raw SQL, use cds.log not console.log, cuid + managed aspects on entities. Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 in app/<name>-ui/, functional components and hooks, API calls isolated in src/api.ts. Always include a readme.md with run instructions and unit tests for business logic.
